title: Archive entity
description: One thing in the archive that can be pointed at: a chapter, a chapter section, a Pantheon figure, a Vault object, a symbol, a Pilgrimage site, a museum room, a game, a ritual, a source and so on. IDs are stable: <type>:<slug>. An ID, once published in framework/registry/, is never reused for something else; if the thing is withdrawn the ID is retired, not reassigned.

id.description: <type>:<slug>. The slug may contain '/' to nest under a parent (e.g. section:ch02/the-negative-confession).

type.description: Must equal the part of id before the colon.

label.description: Name as shown to a reader.

parent.description: ID of the containing entity, if any (a section's chapter, a waypoint's site).

era.description: Era slug, e.g. 04-axial-age, where the thing belongs to one era.

status.description: Publication state copied from the source data (published, pending, queued, live, preview…). The registry records it; it never changes it.

href.description: Path on the site relative to docs/, where one exists.

links.description: IDs of related entities (a figure's home chapters, a relic's chapters).

from.description: The repo file this entry was read from.
